mapper.select: select * from tb_second_hand_product where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.sql: p.id, p.seller_id, u.username as seller_name, p.school_id, s.school_name, p.compus_id, cp.compus_name, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.title, p.description, p.condition_level, p.price, p.pickup_address_id, p.pickup_address_snapshot, p.pickup_only, p.negotiable, p.status, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.create_time, p.update_time
mapper.select: select from tb_second_hand_product p left join tb_user u on p.seller_id = u.id left join tb_school s on p.school_id = s.id left join tb_compus cp on p.compus_id = cp.id left join tb_second_hand_category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.id = #{id} and p.deleted = 0

select from tb_second_hand_product p left join tb_user u on p.seller_id = u.id left join tb_school s on p.school_id = s.id left join tb_compus cp on p.compus_id = cp.id left join tb_second_hand_category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.deleted = 0 and p.seller_id = #{sellerId} order by p.create_time desc
mapper.update: update tb_second_hand_product set status = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 and status = 0
update tb_second_hand_product set status = 2, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update tb_second_hand_product set status = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 and status = 1
update tb_second_hand_product set status = 0, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 and status in (1, 2)
update tb_second_hand_product set status = 3, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update tb_second_hand_product set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update tb_second_hand_product set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
